title: Moment bound by Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n,q$ be natural numbers and let $f$ be a real-valued function on sign vectors of length $n$. The uniform expectation of $f(x)^q$ is at most the sum, over all $q$-tuples of subsets of the coordinates whose symmetric difference is empty, of the absolute value of the product of the corresponding Fourier coefficients of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: a real-valued function on sign vectors of length $n$
